Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collisoin with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted
range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported impact forces, and the presentation fits the expected
pattern for this type of trauma. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to
the same body region is known from the patient history. Conservative management was provided over thirteen visits, including
manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Progress has been somewhat slower than typically
seen with this injury, and the course of care has run a bit longer than usual, though the patient has continued to engage well with
treatment. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for services rendered. Ongoing
rehabilitation and periodic reassessment are planned, with return to usual activities anticipated as strength and mobility improve.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
